title: Apate sends AI agents undercover to get scammed so they can gather fraud intelligence | TechCrunch
summary: Joffe said TPG has diverted nearly 590,000 calls to Apate’s agents, Commonwealth has seen a 76% drop in publicly reported scam losses, and an unnamed Australian bank the startup works with has used its outbound agents to disrupt 22 scam campaigns.
